Title: Question about importing js file in typescript fashion
Description: I am trying to import an existing javascript source file(not a 3rd party module) into my typescript file using `import ... = require()` syntax with no success. Could you please help me point out anything I did wrong in the following isolated example?

add.js

``` javascript
module.exports = function (n1, n2) {
    return n1 + n2;
};
```

add.d.ts

``` typescript
declare module "add" {
    function add(n1: number, n2: number): number;
    export = add;
}
```

main.ts

``` typescript
/// <reference path='node.d.ts' />
/// <reference path='add.d.ts' />
import add = require('./add');
console.log(add(1, 2));
```

When I try to compile `main.ts`, I got the following error:

```
error TS2306: File 'add.d.ts' is not an external module.
```
